0022600178.text: The Memphis Grizzlies host the Indiana Pacers in their eighth game of the season, with Memphis at 6-1, 2nd in the Southwest and 2nd in the West, and a 4-0 road record, though they dropped their most recent game. Indiana is 2-6, 12th in the East, and has lost five straight, going 0-4 at home, with Ben Sheppard, Johnny Furphy, Kelly Oubre Jr., T.J. McConnell and Tyrese Haliburton all unavailable. Memphis is without Scotty Pippen Jr., who is out with back soreness and is averaging 6.4 points in 16.0 minutes, and the Grizzlies won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 125-106 win in Indianapolis on March 1, 2026, while the two teams have not yet played each other this season.
